# Template index

149 templates in 12 groups, the same ones the Postemi composer shows under Templates. 101 of them are hooks (the 7 hook groups). A template can sit in more than one group.

Pick from this list, then open the group file for the full text.

| Group | File | Templates | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Everyday posts | [everyday.md](./everyday.md) | 8 | Simple starters for any channel: news, tips, stories and reminders. |
| Product launch | [launch.md](./launch.md) | 9 | Announce, explain and celebrate what you build. |
| LinkedIn | [linkedin.md](./linkedin.md) | 30 | Post types for founders: building in public, stories, lessons and more. |
| X | [x.md](./x.md) | 10 | Short formats that work on X: takes, lists, polls and how-tos. |
| Lessons and stories | [hook-stories.md](./hook-stories.md) | 17 | Hooks built on your own path: then and now, turning points and lessons. |
| Contrarian takes | [hook-contrarian.md](./hook-contrarian.md) | 14 | Push back on what everyone believes, and say what works instead. |
| Frameworks and how-to | [hook-how-to.md](./hook-how-to.md) | 16 | Steps, frameworks and tips people can use the same day. |
| Lists and tools | [hook-lists.md](./hook-lists.md) | 12 | Tools, resources and people worth saving, one line each. |
| Books and learning | [hook-learning.md](./hook-learning.md) | 17 | Books, quotes, courses and reading lists, boiled down to a post. |
| Habits and growth | [hook-growth.md](./hook-growth.md) | 13 | Benefits, habits and goals that make people want to begin. |
| Problems and questions | [hook-talk.md](./hook-talk.md) | 12 | Name a problem, ask a question and get people talking. |
| Conversation starters | [engagement.md](./engagement.md) | 11 | Questions, polls and prompts that get people to reply. |
